gloss: the very top; summit; crown (of the head)

definitions.gloss: the very top; summit; peak; crown (of the head)
definitions.explanation: The highest point of something: a mountain, tree, tower or a person's head. Also used figuratively for the top of a ranking. Informal and conversational.

examples.japanese: ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧てっぺん⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧。
examples.english: The top of my head feels cold.

examples.japanese: ⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧てっぺん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登|のぼ}った→登る：00660_noboru⟧⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{降|お}りられなく→降りる：00568_oriru⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{鳴|な}いている→鳴く：04388_naku⟧。
examples.english: The cat that climbed to the top of the tree can't get down and is crying.

notes:
Sometimes written {天辺|てっぺん}, but kana is usual. More casual than ⟦{頂上|ちょうじょう}→頂上：03493_choujou⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧てっぺん⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: from head to toe
- てっぺん⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to reach the top (be number one)
- ⟦{塔|とう}→塔：09944_tou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧てっぺん: the top of the tower

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{頂上|ちょうじょう}→頂上：03493_choujou⟧: summit; neutral and more formal
